part1_reference_policy.tie_break: Prefer earlier imagery for equal gaps
part1_reference_policy.interpretation: Selected wetlands are incomplete historical context, not exhaustive wetland ground truth.

lulc_reference_policy.interpretation: 2020 land-cover context only; not confirmed 2018 land cover.

interpretation_limitations: Only 25 selected wetlands are represented in Part 1.
No Part 1 observations are available within 90 days of E001.
Part 1 observations near E002 may share imagery with the event polygons and are not independent validation.
2020 Open Water is not proof of permanent water coverage in 2018.
2020 Wetland/Marsh is not proof of waterlogging during either event.
Raster sampled areas are approximate because boundaries cross 30m cells.
Cloud cover and manual image interpretation introduce uncertainty.
Outside sampled wetlands does not mean confirmed non-wetland.
No confirmed waterlogging or non-waterlogging labels are assigned.
geometry_repair_policy: Invalid event polygons were repaired in memory using buffer(0). Original KML geometries were not modified. Repaired boundaries still require interpretation-quality review.

geometry_repair_summary.spatial_proximity_interpretation: Exact geometric overlap and distance to the historical event footprint are reported separately. A small positive distance indicates proximity, not confirmed overlap or independent evidence of waterlogging. Manual digitization uncertainty must be considered.
